test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution'.

Commodity prices are __dearer__ in the present economic scenario.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. dear .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence aims to describe the current state of commodity prices in the economic scenario.
 
• The phrase "the dearer" is incorrect as "dear" itself means expensive. Using "the" before "dearer" is grammatically incorrect in this context.
 
• To make the sentence grammatically correct, the word "dear" should be used without any article or comparative form.

Correct sentence: *Commodity prices are **dear **in the present economic scenario*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dear (adjective):** This term is used to describe something that is expensive or costly.
 
• **Comparative and Superlative Forms:**
 
 
• **Comparative:** dearer (used when comparing two things)
 
• **Superlative:** dearest (used when comparing more than two things)
